snippet.title: ASTALA MUERTE l Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the shadows of the past in this third-person survival horror game inspired by the golden age of PS1/PS2-era classics. Set in the 1990s, you’ll explore a forgotten underground laboratory where something went horribly wrong and you're trapped in the aftermath. Manage limited resources, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover chilling documents that slowly reveal how — and why — these creatures were brought back. But the truth may be more horrifying than the monsters themselves. This is Chapter One in a series of standalone horror stories, each delving into a different unsolved case. What happened here is just the beginning.

If you´re interested in our project check out our Patreon page:
Patreon.com/AstalaMuerte
